[[Seear Windlash]] is a [[Nightmare]] [[boss]] that spawns in [[Talus Chute]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Talus Chute}}

== Skills ==
16 [[Illusion Magic]] (20 Illusion Magic in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Clumsiness}}
* {{skill icon|Illusion of Weakness}}
* {{skill icon|Illusionary Weaponry}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Azure Remains]]

== Notes ==
* Seear Windlash has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses ([[Nighh SpineChill]], [[Frostbite]] and [[Brrrr Windburn]]). The easiest way to obtain this skill is walking just outside of [[Camp Rankor]]. If he is not there, re-zone and repeat until he spawns.
